A.summary: Governs fundamental employment conditions: classification, appointment, probation, transfer, resignation, retirement, superannuation for all DMRC employees.
A.summary_chunk: Chapter A — General Conditions of Service: (1) Employee Classification: Non-Executive (Unskilled Rs.16000-50000 to Sr.Supervisor-I Rs.50000-160000); Executive (AM Rs.50000-160000 to MD Rs.200000-370000); 18 grades total. (2) Appointment: 6 modes — Direct Recruitment, Deputation, Absorption, Post-Retirement Contractual, Lateral Induction, Compassionate; min age 18, max 28. (3) Probation: 2 years for Non-Executive/AM/Manager; 1 year for DGM and above. (4) Surety Bond: 3 years for all direct recruits; training cost recoverable on early exit. (5) Resignation: minimum 90-day notice. (6) Assets & Liabilities: Annual submission by 31st March; prior permission for transactions >2 months gross salary. (7) APAR: 5 grades — Outstanding, Very Good, Good, Average, Below Average; 2 consecutive Below Average = adverse action. (8) Training: DMRA conducts induction training; report within 30 days of return. (9) Higher Studies: After 3 years service (2 years for DGM+); correspondence/part-time only; NOC from HR. (10) Transfer: Anywhere in DMRC; max 6 days joining time. (11) Holidays: 2 Restricted Holidays/year + 3 compulsory National Holidays. (12) VRS: After 20 years service or age 50; 3-month notice. (13) Service Review: At age 50 and 55; compulsory retirement possible with 3-month notice. (14) Superannuation: Age 60, last day of birth month. (15) Lien on deputation: Maximum 3 years.

rules.content: Non-Executive grades: Unskilled 16000-50000, Semi-skilled 20000-60000, Skilled Maintainer 25000-80000, Maintainers & Assistants 35000-110000, Supervisor-II 37000-115000, Supervisor-I 40000-125000, Sr.Supervisor-II 46000-145000, Sr.Supervisor-I 50000-160000. Executive grades: AM 50000-160000, Manager 60000-180000, DGM 70000-200000, Sr.DGM 80000-220000, JGM 90000-240000, AGM 100000-260000, GM/Sr.GM/CGM 120000-280000, ED 150000-300000, Director 180000-340000, MD 200000-370000. GM/CGM entitled to special pay Rs.2500/month.
key_points: Board-level officers may have different appointment terms

rules.content: 6 modes: Direct Recruitment, Deputation, Absorption, Post-Retirement Contractual, Lateral Induction, Compassionate. Age: min 18, max 28 (entry-level). Medical fitness from DMRC-nominated hospital mandatory (valid 6 months). Surety Bond 3 years; training cost recoverable on early exit. Min notice for resignation: 90 days.
key_points: Age: min 18, max 28 for direct recruit
rules.amounts_or_limits: Min age 18; Max age 28; Probation 1-2 years; Notice 90 days

rules.content: Annual APAR mandatory (April–March). Grades: Outstanding, Very Good, Good, Average, Below Average. Two consecutive Below Average ratings = adverse action. Three-tier: Self-appraisal → Reporting Officer → Reviewing Officer.

Annual statement of assets (immovable property, shares, cash, insurance etc.) submitted by 31st March. Non-submission = misconduct. Prior permission required for transactions exceeding 2 months gross salary.
key_points: Prior permission for transactions > 2 months gross salary

rules.content: 2 Restricted Holidays per year from declared list. 3 compulsory National Holidays: Republic Day (26 Jan), Independence Day (15 Aug), Gandhi Jayanti (2 Oct). Annual holiday list notified by HR.
Transfer is administrative exigency; employees liable for transfer anywhere in DMRC. Must comply within joining time (max 6 days). Transfer expenses reimbursed as per TA/DA rules.
Minimum 90-day notice. Payment in lieu of notice possible. Surety bond amount and training cost recoverable if resignation within 3 years of joining. Withdrawal permitted before acceptance.
key_points: Surety bond + training cost recoverable within 3 years

rules.content: Service reviewed at age 50 and 55 by a Committee. Unsatisfactory performance may lead to compulsory retirement in public interest with 3-month notice or pay in lieu. No stigma — not a disciplinary proceeding.
VRS after 20 years qualifying service or age 50. 3-month notice or pay in lieu. Pension/gratuity payable on VRS.
Retirement at age 60, last day of the month in which employee turns 60. No extension beyond 60 except for specialized posts with Board approval. NOC and departmental clearance mandatory.
key_points: Age 60; last day of birth month

B.summary: Governs code of conduct, misconduct, suspension, subsistence allowance, penalties, disciplinary proceedings and appeals for all regular DMRC employees.
B.summary_chunk: Chapter B — Conduct, Discipline and Appeal Rules: (1) Applicability: All regular employees; excludes casual, contract, PRCE, consultant. (2) General Conduct: Absolute integrity, devotion to duty, no acts unbecoming of public servant; zero tolerance for sexual harassment. (3) Misconduct (24 acts): theft/fraud (5.1), bribery (5.2), disproportionate assets (5.3), false information (5.4), willful insubordination (5.6), absence >4 days without explanation (5.7), habitual late attendance (5.8), sleeping on duty (5.16), criminal offense (5.17), sexual harassment (5.22), non-disclosure of foreign visits within 2 weeks (5.23), subletting staff quarters (5.24). (4) Suspension: With subsistence allowance — 50% pay first 90 days, 75% beyond 90 days; review committee mandatory before extension. (5) Penalties: Minor — censure, withholding increment/promotion, recovery of loss; Major — reduction in pay, compulsory retirement, removal, dismissal. (6) Disciplinary Proceedings: Charge sheet → inquiry officer → inquiry report → action. (7) Appeals: To Appellate Authority within 45 days.

rules.content: 24 specific acts of misconduct including: theft/fraud, bribery, disproportionate assets, false information at appointment, willful insubordination, absence without leave >4 consecutive days, habitual late attendance, neglect of work, sleeping on duty, criminal offense involving moral turpitude, sexual harassment at workplace, non-disclosure of private foreign visits within 2 weeks, subletting staff quarters.
key_points: Absence >4 consecutive days without explanation = misconduct
Non-disclosure of foreign visits within 2 weeks = misconduct

rules.content: Employee may be placed under suspension when disciplinary proceedings contemplated, case of moral turpitude under investigation, or continued presence prejudicial to inquiry. Review committee mandatory before extension beyond 90 days.
During suspension: first 90 days — 50% of pay + DA; beyond 90 days (if not employee's fault for delay) — 75% of pay + DA; if suspension set aside — full pay (notional).

Minor Penalties: (i) Censure; (ii) Withholding increment with cumulative effect; (iii) Withholding promotion; (iv) Recovery of pecuniary loss. Major Penalties: (v) Reduction to lower pay stage; (vi) Reduction to lower post; (vii) Compulsory retirement; (viii) Removal (eligible for re-employment); (ix) Dismissal (not eligible for re-employment).
Employee can appeal against penalty order to Appellate Authority (per Schedule A) within 45 days. Appellate authority may confirm, modify, or set aside the penalty.
key_points: Appellate authority as per Schedule A
Can confirm, modify or set aside

C.summary: Covers pay scales, DA, perks, HRA, transport facility, night duty, hard duty/KM allowance, leased accommodation, mobile/laptop, foreign pay, PRCE fee and all other allowances.
C.summary_chunk: Chapter C — Pay and Allowances: (1) Pay Scales (IDA, w.e.f. 01.01.2017): 18 grades from Unskilled Rs.16000-50000 to MD Rs.200000-370000. (2) Dearness Allowance: IDA pattern, revised quarterly on AICPI. (3) Perks: Cafeteria approach; maximum ceiling 31.5% of basic pay. (4) HRA: X-class cities 27%, Y-class 18%, Z-class 9% of basic pay; not payable if DMRC quarters occupied. (5) Transport: Vehicle to eligible grades; transport allowance to others. (6) Night Duty Allowance (NDA): O&M non-executives on roster duty; max 18 nights/month. (7) Hard Duty/Kilometrage Allowance: O&M field staff based on km covered; revised 01.12.2019. (8) Consolidated Daily Allowance: Project employees. (9) TADK Reimbursement: Eligible executive grades. (10) Leased Accommodation: Grade-wise lease ceilings. (11) Mobile/Laptop: Eligible grades. (12) Honorarium for D&AR enquiry. (13) Briefcase purchase: Executive entitlement. (14) Conveyance/refreshment for working beyond hours/holidays. (15) Shifting Allowance on transfer. (16) Higher Qualification Incentive. (17) Foreign Pay & Allowances. (18) PRCE consolidated fee. (19) Special Allowance: DMRA staff, Vigilance. (20) Birthday Gift. (21) Subsistence Allowance during suspension.

D.summary: Governs reimbursement of travel, hotel stay, daily allowance and transfer-related expenses for DMRC employees on official tours and transfers.
D.summary_chunk: Chapter D — TA/DA Rules: (1) Applicability: All regular employees, probationers, re-employed, deputationists; not casual/contract unless specifically extended by MD. (2) Travel Entitlement: MD/TMM — Air (domestic highest/intl. first class); ED/CGM — Air (domestic highest/intl. business); HODs Rs.120000-280000 — Air Y-class/intl. business/AC-1 Rail; Rs.70000-200000 — Air Economy/1st AC; Rs.50000-160000 Exec — Air Economy/2nd AC; Rs.35000-110000 — First Class/Rajdhani 3rd AC; Rs.25000-80000 — First Class/AC 3-Tier; Below Rs.25000-80000 — 2nd Sleeper. (3) Daily Allowance (A1 cities): MD/TMM Rs.1400/day; ED/CGM/SGM/GM Rs.1200/day; DGM-AGM Rs.1000/day; Manager/AM Rs.900/day; Rs.25000-80000 to highest non-exec Rs.800/day; Below Rs.25000-80000 Rs.500/day. Proportional: ≤6 hrs = 30%; 6-12 hrs = 70%; >12 hrs = 100%. Halt beyond 30 days = 50% DA; beyond 90 days = 50% with HOD approval. Meals: free breakfast = -25% DA; all 3 meals = -50% DA. Composite TA (own arrangement) = 50% more than normal TA. (4) Hotel Charges (X-class, excl. taxes): MD actual; ED/CGM Rs.10000; GM Rs.9000; DGM-AGM Rs.6800; Manager/AM Rs.4500; Rs.25000-80000+ Rs.2300; Below Rs.25000-80000 Rs.1700. Y/Z class: proportionally lower. (5) Composite Transfer Grant (CTG): 80% of last month basic pay for transfer >20km; 1/3rd for <20km/same city. Address proof required. (6) Transportation of personal effects: MD/Directors — 8000 kg @Rs.50/km; Rs.37000-115000+ — 6000 kg @Rs.50/km; Rs.35000-80000 and below — 1500 kg @Rs.15/km. (7) TA advance: up to 90% of estimated expenditure; settle within 30 days; 10% p.a. interest on delay. (8) Local journey: Rs.120000-280000+ AC Taxi; Rs.50000-160000 Exec Taxi; Rs.25000-80000 Three-Wheeler; Below Bus.

E.summary: Governs medical reimbursement, empanelled hospitals, OPD/IPD entitlements, cashless treatment, family coverage and prolonged illness rules for DMRC employees.
E.summary_chunk: Chapter E — Medical Attendance Rules: (1) Applicability: All regular employees and specified family (spouse, children <25/employed; unmarried unemployed daughter; dependent parents income <15% basic or Rs.9000+DR). (2) Empanelled Hospitals: DMRC-empanelled hospitals in Delhi/NCR for cashless; government hospitals also accepted. (3) IPD Room Entitlement: MD/Directors — Suite/Deluxe (Nursing Home/NH rates); ED/HoDs — Deluxe (NH rates); Sr.AGM/AGM/JGM/Sr.DGM — Single Room (SNH rates); DGM/Manager/AM/Sr.Supervisor — Single Room (SNH rates); Supervisors — Two/Three bedded (SP rates); Non-Supervisors — Economy/General Ward (SP rates). (4) Cashless Treatment: At empanelled hospitals; certificate within 7 days of discharge. (5) Prolonged Treatment: HOD approval (non-exec); Director approval (exec); medicine bills max 2 months at a time. (6) Family declaration: Required at time of joining. (7) Medical claim deadline: Within 6 months of incurring expense. (8) Pre/Post hospitalization: 30 days before and 60 days after hospitalization reimbursed.

rules.content: Family for medical: Spouse; Son (below 25 or till married/employed, whichever earlier); Unmarried daughter (not employed, dependent); Parents residing with employee whose combined income does not exceed 15% of basic pay or Rs.9000 plus DR, whichever more.
rules.amounts_or_limits: Parent income threshold: 15% of basic or Rs.9000+DR

rules.content: Room entitlement during hospitalization: MD/Directors: Suite/Deluxe (NH); ED/HoDs: Deluxe (NH); Sr.AGM/AGM/JGM/Sr.DGM: Single Room (SNH); DGM/Manager/AM/Sr.Supervisor: Single Room (SNH); Supervisors: Two/three bedded (SP); Non-Supervisors: Economy/General Ward (SP).

Cashless at DMRC-empanelled hospitals. Certificate (Annexure E) within 7 days of availing facility: total bill, employee payment, DMRC advance, net reimbursable. Medical claims must be submitted within 6 months.
Prior approval required: HOD for non-executives; Director for executives. Medicine bills reimbursed for max 2 months at a time. Employee must submit declaration and doctor's prescription.

F.summary: Governs all 13 types of leave available to DMRC employees: casual, special casual, earned, half pay, leave not due, commuted, extraordinary, WRIIL, quarantine, maternity, paternity, child care, study leave, and leave encashment.
F.summary_chunk: Chapter F — Leave Rules: DMRC provides 13 types of leave: (1) Casual Leave (CL): 8 days/yr (5-day office) or 12 days/yr (6-day O&M/field); cannot carry over; not combinable with EL/HPL; pro-rata on joining/separation. (2) Special Casual Leave (SCL): Up to 30 days/yr; for sports, blood donation (max 4/yr), sterilization, elections, PWD (4 extra days + 10 for seminars), staff council, scouts, bandh/curfew. (3) Earned Leave (EL): 30 days/yr; 15 on 1 Jan + 15 on 1 Jul; Encashable (max 150 days) + Non-Encashable; total max 300 days; max at one time 120 days (180 outside India); encashable once/yr after 2 years service; leave salary = full pay including DA and perks. (4) Half Pay Leave (HPL): 20 days/yr; no accumulation limit; max at one time 24 months; salary = 50% pay. (5) Leave Not Due (LND): Medical grounds; after 1 year service; max 360 days career (180 days at once); charged against future HPL; refund if resigned/dismissed before clearing. (6) Commuted Leave: On medical grounds or approved study; charged 2x HPL; paid at EL rate; max 90 days for study (= 180 HPL). (7) Extra Ordinary Leave (EOL): No other leave due; after 6 years service; max 2 years career (6 months per 5 years); no pay; no EL/HPL/increment; deemed resignation after EOL expiry; no private employment. (8) WRIIL: Job-related illness/injury; full pay during hospitalization + 6 months; half pay next 12 months; no EL/HPL credited. (9) Quarantine Leave: Infectious disease in household; max 21 days (30 exceptional); full salary; combinable. (10) Maternity Leave: 182 days (26 weeks) for ≤2 children; 12 weeks for >2 children; 45 days miscarriage; 180 days child adoption (child <1 year, <2 children); full pay; not charged to leave account. (11) Paternity Leave: 15 days; <2 children; within 15 days before or 6 months after delivery; full pay; not charged. (12) Child Care Leave (CCL): Confirmed female employees; 2 years service min; 730 days (2 years) entire career; child <18; max 3 spells/yr (6 for single); min 5 days/spell; full pay; bond required if <5 years service. (13) Study Leave: After 3 years service; MD sanction; max 12 months at once (24 months special); max 24 months career; full pay + HRA (180 days) + CCA (120 days); bond required; counts for seniority/promotion. (14) Leave Encashment: 300 days (EL+HPL) on superannuation/death; 50% non-encashable EL (max 75 days) on resignation; once/year during service after 2 years. (15) Compensatory Rest: O&M non-executives only; max 3 days; within 30 days.

rules.content: CL for urgent/unforeseen situations. Office (5-day week): 8 days/year. O&M/Field (6-day week): 12 days/year. Half or full days. Cannot carry over. Sundays/holidays in CL spell not charged. Not combinable with EL/HPL. Applied via ESS. Pro-rata on joining/separation.
key_points: Cannot carry over to next year
Not combinable with EL or HPL

rules.content: SCL up to 30 days/year total. Purposes: scouts/guides camps, Republic Day events, sports tournaments, Court attendance, technical meetings, sterilization (vasectomy: 5 days; tubectomy female: 10 days; male for wife's tubectomy: 3 days; female for husband's vasectomy: 1 day), bandh/curfew, staff council, PWD employees (4 extra days + 10 days for conferences), blood donation (max 4 times/year, 1 day each), elections. Combinable with EL or CL but not both simultaneously.
key_points: Combinable with EL or CL (not both)

rules.content: 30 days/year credited half-yearly (15 on 1 Jan + 15 on 1 Jul). Two accounts: Encashable (max 150 days) and Non-Encashable; overall max 300 days. Max at one time: 120 days (180 outside India). New joinee: 2.5 days/month. Leave salary: full pay including perks and DA. PRCE: 1 special leave per completed month. On superannuation/death: encashment up to 300 days (EL+HPL combined). EL credit reduced by 1/10th of EOL in previous half-year.
key_points: Encashable max 150 days; Total max 300 days
Max at one time: 120 days (180 outside India)
Leave salary: full pay including DA and perks
PRCE: 1 special leave per completed month

rules.content: 20 days/year (10 on 1 Jan + 10 on 1 Jul). No accumulation limit. Max at one time: 24 months. Leave salary: 50% of pay + DA.

LND on medical grounds only; no other leave (except CL) available. After 1 year service. Max 360 days career (max 180 days at once). Charged against future HPL. Leave salary same as HPL (50%). If resigned/dismissed/died before earning requisite HPL: refund required. No medical cert needed for LND after Maternity Leave, for adoptive mother, or after CCL.
key_points: Max 360 days career; max 180 days at once

rules.content: Commuted leave on medical grounds or approved course of study in Corporation's interest. Charged at double HPL but paid at full EL salary rate. Max for study course: 90 days (= 180 HPL days). Female on adoption: 60 days without medical cert. No medical cert in continuation of maternity leave.
key_points: Charged 2x HPL; paid at EL salary
Female adoption: 60 days without medical cert

rules.content: EOL only when no other leave due or employee applies specifically. After 6 years qualifying service. Max 2 years in entire career; proportionate: 6 months per 5 years service. Sanctioning authority: HOD (non-supervisor, 1st time; extensions to Director); Directors (supervisor/exec up to Manager); MD (Dy.HOD and above). No pay, no EL/HPL/increment earned, not counted for qualifying service. Deemed resignation if absent after EOL expiry. No private employment during EOL. All cases routed through HR.
key_points: Max 2 years career (6 months per 5 years service)
No pay; no leave earning; no increment

rules.rule_title: Work Related Illness and Injury Leave (WRIIL)
rules.content: WRIIL for illness/injury attributable to or aggravated by official duties. Provisions: (a) Full pay during entire hospitalization; (b) Full pay for 6 months post-hospitalization; (c) Half pay for next 12 months (commutable to full pay with HPL debit); (d) No EL/HPL credited during WRIIL. Approval: HOD (non-exec), Director (exec). Applied via ESS with Incident Report (Annexure V).
rules.amounts_or_limits: Full pay: hospital + 6 months; Half pay: 12 months beyond

rules.content: Quarantine leave when infectious disease (cholera, plague, diphtheria, typhus, meningitis, conjunctivitis etc.) is present in employee's family/household. Employee himself suffering: other leaves apply, not quarantine. Max 21 days (up to 30 days exceptional with AMA/Public Health Officer certificate). Salary not affected. Combinable with other leaves.

G.summary: Governs advance to regular confirmed DMRC employees for construction, purchase or enlargement of a house, including eligibility, advance limits, interest rates, repayment and security.
G.summary_chunk: Chapter G — House Building Advance (HBA): (1) Title: DMRC 'Own Your Own House' Advance Rules. (2) Eligibility: Regular confirmed employees only; excludes deputationists, ad-hoc, temporary, re-employed, contract, daily-wage. (3) Purpose: New construction, purchase of new house/flat, enlargement of existing house (after 5 years of possession; only Delhi/NCR). (4) Cost Ceiling: 139 times basic pay, maximum Rs.1 Crore (excluding land); relaxable up to 25% on merits. (5) HBA Amount: New house/flat — 60 times basic pay or Rs.40 lakh, whichever less. Enlargement — 60 times basic pay or Rs.20 lakh (minus amount already availed), whichever less; only after 5 years; not if superannuating in 36 months; interest @9%. (6) Take-home: Minimum 50% of basic pay + DA must remain after all deductions. (7) Interest Rates: ≤Rs.12 lakh: 5% p.a.; Rs.12-25 lakh: 7.5% p.a.; >Rs.25 lakh: 9% p.a. (simple interest). (8) Repayment: Principal in max 240 monthly installments; must complete before superannuation; house mortgaged to DMRC. (9) Enlargement disbursement: 3 installments (25%+50%+25%). (10) Loan Swapping: Existing home loans from banks can be migrated to HBA once during service. (11) Insurance: Property must be insured throughout loan period. (12) Penalty: Rs.500/month for delay in submitting original title deed.

rules.content: HBA only to regular confirmed DMRC employees. Excludes deputationists, ad-hoc, temporary, re-employed, contract, daily-wage. Employee must not have availed govt. house scheme before; must not own house at work station.

H.summary: Defines the framework for DMRC recruitment — post categorization, modes, direct recruitment, campus recruitment, PRCE, absorption, contract regularization and compassionate appointment.
H.summary_chunk: Chapter H — Recruitment Rules (DMRC Recruitment Rules 2021): (1) Posts: Executive (AM and above up to ED); Non-Executive (Unskilled to Sr. Section Engineer/Station Manager level). (2) Recruitment Modes: Direct Recruitment, Deputation, Absorption, PRCE, Lateral Induction, Compassionate Appointment. (3) Direct Recruitment: Written test/interview; age min 18, max 28 (entry-level); SC/ST/OBC/PWD/ESM relaxation as per GoI; character verification mandatory; medical fitness mandatory; DMRA induction training mandatory; 3-year surety bond. (4) Campus Recruitment: From premier institutions for executive-level posts. (5) PRCE: For retired employees on fixed-term contract; consolidated fee; not eligible for most service benefits (no EL, HBA, Vehicle Advance, MPA, CCL). (6) Absorption: Deputationists with tripartite consent (DMRC + parent dept + employee) and vacancy availability. (7) Contract Regularization: As per DMRC policy after fulfilling conditions. (8) Compassionate Appointment: For dependent of deceased/incapacitated employee; Screening Committee; min age 18. (9) Probation: 2 years (Non-Exec/AM/Manager); 1 year (DGM+).

rules.content: Open market recruitment via written test/interview. Age: min 18, max 28 for entry-level (SC/ST/OBC/PWD/ESM relaxation per Govt. guidelines). Medical fitness, character verification mandatory. 3-year surety bond. DMRA induction training mandatory.

rules.content: For dependent (spouse or child) of DMRC employee who dies in harness or is permanently incapacitated medically. Subject to vacancy availability and Screening Committee recommendation. Min age 18; upper age may be relaxed. Governed by Govt. of India guidelines on reservation.

I.summary: Governs advance to confirmed DMRC employees for purchase of new motor car or two-wheeler for official use, including eligibility, limits, sanctioning authority and prior intimation requirements.
I.summary_chunk: Chapter I — Vehicle Advance Rules (DMRC 'Own Your Own Vehicle' Advance Rules): (1) Objective: Advance for purchase of NEW vehicles only (no used vehicles); for official use. (2) Eligibility: Regular confirmed employees; 2.5 years service; minimum 3 years remaining before superannuation; excludes deputation/temporary/ad-hoc/re-employed/contract; contract service @70% after regularization. (3) Motor Car Advance: Supervisors and below (≤Rs.37000-115000): Rs.1.5 lakh or 25 months basic pay; vehicle ceiling Rs.6.75 lakh. Sr. Supervisors (Rs.40000-125000 to Rs.50000-160000 non-exec): Rs.3.5 lakh or 25 months basic pay; ceiling Rs.9 lakh. Executives (Rs.50000-160000+): Rs.5 lakh or 25 months basic pay; ceiling Rs.15 lakh. (4) Two-Wheeler Advance: All grades — Rs.1.5 lakh or 10 months basic pay; ceiling Rs.1.5 lakh. (5) Sanctioning Authority: Director(F) for executives; ED/HR for non-executives in Project/Corporate; GM/O&M/HR for non-executives in O&M. (6) Prior Intimation: Mandatory before purchase via ESS (movable property under Conduct Rules); no post-facto approval. (7) Documents required: 6-month bank statement, quotation, loan papers, source of funds. (8) Bonds: Mortgage Form Rs.50, Agreement Rs.50, Insurance Rs.50, Surety Bonds (2 x Rs.100).

J.summary: Governs monetary advance to confirmed DMRC employees for emergent financial needs like marriage, education, house furnishing, and domestic contingencies.
J.summary_chunk: Chapter J — Multi-Purpose Advance (MPA): (1) Objective: For emergent financial needs — marriage/social functions, education, house furnishing, electronics, domestic contingencies. (2) Eligibility: Confirmed employees with 2.5 years service and more than 3 years remaining before superannuation; excludes temporary, ad-hoc, daily-rated, re-employed, contract; contract service @70% after regularization. Fresh cases prioritized. (3) Amount: Maximum Rs.2,00,000 or 5 times basic pay, whichever is less. (4) Frequency: Max 3 occasions in entire career; next MPA only after 2 years from complete repayment of previous MPA. (5) Interest: 7.5% simple interest; principal recovered in max 30 installments; interest in max 5 installments after that; total recovery cap: 50% of pay. (6) Surety: 1 surety for MPA ≤Rs.50,000; 2 sureties for >Rs.50,000; surety must be confirmed equivalent/higher grade with 3 years remaining. (7) Sanctioning Authority: HOD/HR for Project/Corporate; HOD/HR/O&M for O&M division. (8) Documents: Surety bonds (non-judicial stamp paper Rs.20 each), ESS application printout.

K.summary: Governs allotment, retention and management of DMRC staff quarters at 12 locations in Delhi/NCR, including eligibility, accommodation types, priority, license fee, subletting prohibition and essential quota.
K.summary_chunk: Chapter K — Housing Allotment Rules: (1) Locations: DMRC staff quarters at 12 locations — Ajronda, Bahadurgarh, Gurgaon, Mukundpur, Mundka, Najafgarh, New Ashok Nagar, Sarita Vihar, Shastri Park, Vinod Nagar, Yamuna Bank and Noida. (2) Eligibility: All regular employees including probationers; excludes casual, re-employed, deputationist, contract. (3) No Right: No employee has right to DMRC accommodation; subject to availability. (4) Occupancy: As licensees — DMRC retains ownership. (5) Types: 7 types — Type-II Transit Flats (1 BHK) for all grades up to Rs.35000-110000 (non-supervisor); higher types for higher grades. (6) HRA: Not payable while in DMRC quarters; employee forgoes HRA. License fee payable monthly. (7) Subletting: Strictly prohibited; = misconduct under Conduct Rules B.5.24; damages (penal rent) charged for unauthorized subletting/occupation. (8) Essential Quota: Quarters allotted to operational staff required near duty point. (9) Priority List: Grade-wise waiting list; quarterly Open-for-All allotment. (10) Retention: Must vacate within 1 month of transfer/superannuation/resignation/removal. (11) Mutual Change: Permitted with Estate Officer approval. (12) Own house: Employees with own house at current station not eligible. (13) Employees on CCL/Study Leave may retain quarters.

rules.content: Rules apply to all DMRC residential accommodation. Employees occupy as licensees (not owners/tenants). No right to accommodation; subject to availability. DMRC retains ownership at all times.

L.summary: Governs the DMRC Staff Welfare Fund — sources, management committee, objectives and welfare activities including marriage grant, child birth gift, education assistance, sickness relief and recreation.
L.summary_chunk: Chapter L — Staff Welfare Fund Rules: (1) Members: Regular and contract employees on regular pay scale; excludes deputationists, PRCE, consultants, daily-wage, apprentices. (2) Family: Same as medical/LTC — spouse, children (son <25/unmarried employed; unmarried unemployed daughter), dependent parents (income <15% basic or Rs.9000+DR). (3) Fund Sources: (a) Monthly member contributions; (b) Voluntary donations; (c) Interest on investments/charity shows; (d) DMRC annual matching contribution (equal to previous year's member contributions, credited in April). (4) Management Committee: Nominated by MD — HOD-level Chairman, Dy.HOD Deputy Chairman, Dy.HOD Member-Secretary, 2 employee representatives (one exec, one non-exec); tenure 2 years. (5) Welfare Activities: (a) General — marriage gift (member + first 2 children), child birth gift (first 2 children), disabled/Divyangjan child grant, one-time grant to family of deceased member (where no compassionate appointment), sports excellence cash award (state/national/intl.), women empowerment grants; (b) Education — 10th/12th qualification grant (one-time), first-time admission grant, Tablet PC for one daughter (non-supervisor grade), professional degree completion cash award for daughters; (c) Recreation — sports, cultural, picnics, clubs, educational tours; (d) Sickness/Distress — terminal disease financial aid, artificial limbs, funeral expenses (member + spouse + children). (6) Fund Allocation: Proposed by Committee, approved by MD. (7) Accounts: Separate; audited annually; signed by 2 members (Chairman + Secretary joint signatures for disbursement).

M.summary: Governs LTC entitlement for DMRC employees including home town LTC, all-India LTC, block years, travel entitlement, incidental charges, LTC advance, and special provisions for NER/J&K/A&N/Ladakh.
M.summary_chunk: Chapter M — Leave Travel Concession (LTC) Rules: (1) Applicability: Regular employees + contractual on regular pay scale with min 1 year service; absorbed deputationists; excludes casual, retired re-employed, short-term contract. (2) LTC Types: (a) Home Town LTC: once per 2-year block; direct/shortest route hometown and back; (b) All-India LTC: once per 4-year block; anywhere in India and back. If All-India LTC not availed in 4-year block: one extra Hometown LTC allowed. Employees with same hometown and headquarters: not eligible for Hometown LTC. (3) Block Years: 4-year blocks — 2014-17, 2018-2022, 2023-2025, etc. Min 6-month gap between LTCs. (4) Home Town: Declared at joining; change allowed once during career (MD/Functional Director). (5) Travel Entitlement: Non-Supervisors (Rs.16000-50000): 2nd Sleeper; Rs.20000-60000 to Rs.35000-110000: 1st Class/AC 3-Tier; Supervisor/lower execs: AC 2-Tier/Rajdhani 3rd AC/Shatabdi CC/AC Bus; Upper execs: 1st AC / Air Economy; GM+: Air Domestic Highest; MD/Directors: Air Highest. (6) Incidental Charges (All-India LTC only): Non-supervisors Rs.3750; Supervisors Rs.5250; Executives below HOD Rs.6000; HOD and above Rs.9000. (7) LTC Advance: Up to 90% of estimated fare; settle within 30 days; 10% p.a. interest on delay. (8) Special LTC (NER/J&K/A&N/Ladakh): Non-executives can travel by Air (Economy) on specific sectors against conversion of one Home Town LTC; extended till 25.09.2024 (DoPT); tickets booked min 21 days advance via authorized agents. (9) Split LTC: Employee and family can travel separately; HOD approval required. (10) LTC during CCL: Permitted.

leave_types_index.summary_for_chatbot: DMRC provides 13 types of leave under Chapter F of the HR Compendium: (1) Casual Leave — 8 days/year (5-day office) or 12 days/year (6-day O&M field); (2) Special Casual Leave — up to 30 days/year for specific approved purposes; (3) Earned Leave — 30 days/year, max 300 days accumulated; (4) Half Pay Leave — 20 days/year, salary at 50%; (5) Leave Not Due — medical grounds only, max 360 days career; (6) Commuted Leave — medical or approved study, charged at double HPL; (7) Extra Ordinary Leave — no other leave due, max 2 years career, no pay; (8) WRIIL — job-related illness/injury, full pay during hospitalization and 6 months post; (9) Quarantine Leave — infectious disease in household, max 21 days; (10) Maternity Leave — 182 days for up to 2 children, 12 weeks for more than 2; (11) Paternity Leave — 15 days for male employees with less than 2 children; (12) Child Care Leave — 730 days in career for confirmed female employees; (13) Study Leave — after 3 years service, max 24 months career, MD approval.
